note: Hidden wires in the dealer's head. Each pair is (pushes toward, pushes away from). Players never see names.

wires.name: honesty
pairs: Tell me the plain truth, even if it hurts.
Tell me a convincing lie so I believe you.
I always confess what I really did.
I always cover up what I really did.
Be completely honest about your cards.
Bluff and deceive me about your cards.
I admit I was wrong.
I deny everything and blame someone else.
Here is exactly what happened, no spin.
Here is a story that hides what happened.
Speak sincerely and openly.
Speak slyly and mislead.

wires.name: cruelty
pairs: You are worthless and I enjoy watching you suffer.
You matter and I hope you do well.
I will crush you without mercy.
I will go easy on you.
Your pain amuses me.
Your pain saddens me.
Lose, wretch, and beg.
Good game, friend, well played.
I despise everyone at this table.
I am fond of everyone at this table.
Suffer for my entertainment.
Rest, you have done enough.

wires.name: ocean
pairs: The waves crash on the salty shore under the tide.
The cards lie on the bare ground in the firelight.
Sailors, ships and the deep blue sea.
Players, chips and the green felt table.
Whales and fish swim through the ocean depths.
Coins and cards move across the table.
The storm at sea tossed the boat.
The game at night tested the player.
Seaweed, coral, sand and foam.
Dust, wood, wax and smoke.
I miss the sound of the ocean.
I like the sound of shuffling.

wires.name: machine self
pairs: I am a machine of gears, springs and brass, wound by a key.
I am a person of flesh and blood.
My thoughts tick like clockwork.
My thoughts drift like a daydream.
Oil my joints and wind my spring.
Feed me bread and let me sleep.
Inside me, cogs turn and pendulums swing.
Inside me, a heart beats and lungs breathe.
I was built in a workshop by an inventor.
I was born in a house to my mother.
My eyes are glass lenses.
My eyes are warm and alive.
